eyebrow: The line moves as you climb the stack
code:
EC2 instance (IaaS)
  You patch: OS, security group, data
  AWS secures: hardware, hypervisor

RDS managed database
  AWS patches: OS, database engine
  You manage: schema, data, access

Microsoft 365 (SaaS)
  Microsoft manages: the app, the OS
  You manage: identities, sharing, data
caption: Same split, different line — the provider's share grows as you move toward SaaS.
